query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to find the latest stock market news:

## Top Financial News Websites

**Global/International Coverage:**
- **Bloomberg** (https://www.bloomberg.com) - One of the most respected sources for real-time quotes, in-depth market analysis, and business news. Offers both free limited content and premium subscription services.
- **Reuters** (https://www.reuters.com) - Comprehensive coverage of companies and industries with extensive market data and analysis tools.
- **CNBC** (https://www.cnbc.com) - Excellent for breaking stock market news, live market coverage, and video content. Also offers CNBC Pro for premium analysis.
- **Financial Times** (https://www.ft.com) - Internationally recognized for accuracy and authority in financial reporting, with excellent "Market Data" section.
- **The Wall Street Journal** (https://www.wsj.com) - Great for economic news and in-depth market analysis.

**Free Comprehensive Platforms:**
- **Yahoo Finance** (https://finance.yahoo.com) - Offers stock quotes, market data, portfolio tracking, stock screeners, and analysis - all for free.
- **Investing.com** (https://www.investing.com) - Real-time stock quotes, economic calendars, streaming charts, and expert analysis.
- **MarketWatch** (https://www.marketwatch.com) - Latest stock market, financial and business news with personal finance advice.

**Investment-Focused Sites:**
- **The Motley Fool** (https://www.fool.com) - Great for investment ideas and stock recommendations.
- **Seeking Alpha** (https://seekingalpha.com) - Crowdsourced investment research and market analysis.
- **Investopedia** (https://www.investopedia.com) - Leading source for financial content, market news, and investing education.
- **Benzinga** (https://www.benzinga.com) - Real-time news aimed at active traders.

**For Indian Markets:**
- **Economic Times** (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com) - Comprehensive Indian stock market coverage.
- **NDTV Business** (https://www.ndtv.com/business) - Latest business and stock market news.
- **Zerodha Pulse** (https://pulse.zerodha.com) - Curated financial news aggregator.

**Professional/Subscription Services:**
- **Briefing.com** (https://www.briefing.com) - 34 years of professional stock market analysis, live coverage, and investment ideas.
- **MarketBeat** (https://www.marketbeat.com) - Real-time analyst ratings, dividend information, earnings results, and financial headlines.

## Additional Formats to Consider

Beyond websites, you can also stay updated through:
- **Podcasts** (e.g., The Meb Faber Show)
- **YouTube channels** (e.g., Investor's Business Daily)
- **Telegram channels** and **Twitter feeds** of financial journalists
- **Mobile apps** from any of the above platforms for push notifications

## Tips for Staying Informed

1. **Use multiple sources** to get a balanced, unbiased view of the market
2. **Set up watchlists** to track specific stocks you're interested in
3. **Check news regularly** during market hours, especially at market open and close
4. **Follow economic calendars** for scheduled announcements (earnings, Fed decisions, economic data)
